import statistics
import math

def percentile_type7(data, p):
    """Type 7 percentile method with linear interpolation"""
    n = len(data)
    k = (n + 1) * p / 100
    f = math.floor(k)
    c = math.ceil(k)
    
    if f == c:
        return data[int(k) - 1]
    
    # Linear interpolation
    d0 = data[f - 1] * (c - k)
    d1 = data[c - 1] * (k - f)
    return d0 + d1
